  "sections": [
    {
      "title": "Section 1: Fundamentals of Graph Connectivity",
      "topics": [
        "Topic 1.1: Introduction to Paths and Circuits in Undirected Graphs",

        "Topic 1.4: Measuring Connectivity: Cut Vertices and Cut Edges",

        "Topic 1.8: Practice and Assessment on Connectivity Concepts"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Section 2: Euler and Hamilton Paths & Circuits",
      "topics": [

        "Topic 2.2: Defining Euler Paths and Circuits",
        "Topic 2.3: Conditions for the Existence of Euler Paths and Circuits",
        "Topic 2.4: Algorithms for Finding Euler Circuits (Fleury's & Hierholzer's)",

        "Topic 2.6: The Traveling Salesman Problem as a Hamilton Circuit Problem",
        "Topic 2.7: Rules and Heuristics for Finding Hamilton Circuits",

        "Topic 2.9: Practice and Assessment on Euler and Hamilton Paths"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Section 3: The Shortest Path Problem",
      "topics": [
        "Topic 3.1: Introduction to Weighted Graphs and Shortest Path Problem Types",
        "Topic 3.2: Dijkstra's Algorithm for Single-Source Shortest Path (Positive Weights)",
        "Topic 3.3: The Bellman-Ford Algorithm for Handling Negative Weights",
        "Topic 3.4: The Floyd-Warshall Algorithm for All-Pairs Shortest Path",
        "Topic 3.5: Ford's Algorithm for Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs)",

        "Topic 3.7: Practice and Assessment on Floyd-Warshall and Ford's Algorithms"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Section 4: Advanced Path-Finding Problems",
      "topics": [
        "Topic 4.1: Exploring Other Shortest Path Problems (Multicriteria, k-Shortest Paths)",
